# Synthetic Pack200 fixture

`resources.pack.gz` contains the synthetic ELF generated by
`tests/aten_native_fixture.py`, plus a public test-only self-signed certificate
and private key under `res/client.crt` and `res/client.key`. The key is not an
application credential and must never be used outside tests.

Generated with the pinned Pack200 Java packer (`Pack200.Packer.SEGMENT_LIMIT=-1`)
from a ZIP containing those three entries, then gzip-compressed with mtime 0.
Tests use the native decoder only; Java is not a runtime or test dependency.

`ast-vectors.json` contains synthetic JPEG coefficient streams generated for this test and pixel results from kelleyk/noVNC `bmc-support` AST2100 decoder. Each luma block has AC coefficients at scan position 1 and natural position 53; other coefficients are zero. Vectors cover all 12 quantization selectors and both 444/422 modes. No device capture or vendor binary is included.
